summary: JIT provisioning fails for contractors when SCIM externalId is mixed-case and suffixed — oncall role not assigned
description: Issue summary: Several contractor accounts are not getting the OnCall Runbook role during just-in-time (JIT) provisioning. Impact: ~12 contractors could not see/claim oncall shifts for the past 36 hours; blockers for rotation coverage and pager escalation. Environment: production, us-east region. Observed behavior: identity-service receives SCIM user create events but RBAC lookup does not match existing contractor mappings; result is user is created without oncall role. Expected behavior: JIT path should normalize SCIM externalId and apply the appropriate contractor role mapping so users can access OnCall Runbook and related tooling.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Create or update a SCIM user in Okta with externalId="MikeChen::Contractor" (mixed case + suffix).
2) Ensure SCIM user is in group 'contractors-oncall' during initial sync or JIT flow.
3) Trigger a login flow (SSO) for that user to cause JIT provisioning.
4) Observe identity-service logs and check OnCall Runbook console for role assignment — user appears without 'oncall-runbook' role and receives 403 when accessing runbook pages.
logs: 2026-03-05T14:12:03Z identity-service WARN externalId mismatch: received 'MikeChen::Contractor' expected 'mikechen'
2026-03-05T14:12:03Z rbac-service INFO rbac-lookup key not found for externalId 'MikeChen::Contractor'
2026-03-05T14:12:04Z oncall-tool ERROR access denied for internal_id=null (no role assigned)
investigation_notes: Initial triage by Support (S. Ortiz): problem began after bulk SCIM provisioning run on 2026-03-04 evening; sample affected accounts all have externalId values with mixed casing and a '::Contractor' suffix added by a downstream HR script.

Hypothesis A (Devon Li): JIT path was changed last quarter to do a strict equality lookup against stored externalId for RBAC mapping; it does not perform the same canonicalization used by the nightly SCIM reconciliation job.
Hypothesis B (Priya Nair): RBAC mapping also uses a 'canonical_external_id' index that was populated by a lowercasing pipeline which the JIT flow bypasses, causing misses for new JIT creations.

Partial finding: nightly reconciliation (scim-reconcile job) normalizes and strips suffixes when writing canonical IDs — JIT provisioning did not run that code path and therefore created accounts without the expected canonical key.
comments: Samantha Ortiz (Support) 2026-03-05T15:02: Support observed ~12 users reported by engineering rotation leads. Slack thread: #internal-support (link: https://slack.redwood.com/internal-support/CH12345).

Devon Li (Identity) 2026-03-05T16:10: Confirmed reproduction in staging with SCIM user externalId="AliceSmith::Contractor" — JIT create path preserved externalId verbatim and RBAC lookup failed. Opened debug branch to add normalization in JIT path.

Priya Nair (SRE) 2026-03-06T09:44: Noted that oncall-tool access logs show 403s and missing role metadata for affected users. Added temporary tracking metric on 'jit_missing_canonical_id' for the next 24h.

Devon Li (Identity) 2026-03-06T18:20: Deployed hotfix to identity-service (hotfix/jit-normalize-externalid) to lowercase and strip known suffix patterns before RBAC lookup. Patch rolled to staging and run through smoke tests.

Samantha Ortiz (Support) 2026-03-07T10:15: Confirmed 10/12 previously blocked contractors now have oncall role and can claim shifts. Two accounts required manual reconciliation due to malformed externalId (non-ASCII chars).
resolution: Hotfix deployed 2026-03-06: JIT provisioning path now applies canonicalization (lowercase, strip '::contractor' and similar suffixes) before RBAC lookup. Backfilled canonical_external_id for affected users via scim-reconcile job. 10 of 12 accounts auto-fixed; 2 required manual correction and email follow-up. Follow-up: add SCIM schema validation to prevent suffix injection, add unit tests for canonicalization behavior, and run a one-off audit across all contractors to detect other malformed externalId formats.
